countries.reasoning: China is the dominant global producer of PVDF, supported by recent industry reports and market analyses from 2022-2023; data from Chinese manufacturers and trade statistics confirm its leading position.

US production is significant due to large chemical companies with PVDF capacity; data from industry reports and US trade statistics are relatively recent and reliable but less comprehensive than China's.
Germany produces PVDF through major chemical firms; EU statistical data and industry reports from 2021-2023 support this estimate with moderate confidence.
South Korea is a known producer with growing chemical industry export data; less publicly available detailed data leads to moderate confidence.
Japan is a notable PVDF producer with established chemical manufacturers; however, exact recent production figures are limited, so estimate has moderate uncertainty.
